com.invoiceparserpro/capability.description: Restore the selected invoice from trash while it remains within its retention period. Review and confirm the exact change first. The preview expires after five minutes.
examples: Preview restoring the invoice we selected from trash. Show its identity and wait for my confirmation.

description: Apply only the exact change returned by preview_restore_invoice, after the user confirms that preview. Accepts its confirmation_token only; changed or expired records require a new preview. Prepare restoring an exact invoice from restorable trash. Requires confirmation, edit and workspace invoice-view permissions.

confirmation_token.description: The exact token returned by this operation’s preview, after the user confirms its displayed changes.
confirmation_token.title: Confirmation Token

name: restore_invoice
title: Restore an invoice
